subject: [AMBER] electric field availability in the CUDA code

messages.author: Sally Pias
messages.body:
Amber developers,
It is my understanding that the electric field parameters (efx, efy, efz,
and efn) are not yet implemented in pmemd.cuda. Is that correct? If so, are
there any plans to implement an electric field option for GPU simulations?
Thanks,
Sally Pias
-- 
Sally Pias
sallypias.gmail.com

messages.author: Sally Pias
messages.body:
Thank you, Dave! It seems to be working.
Much appreciated,
Sally

> following functionality is also supported by the GPU version of
